transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… things have just felt kind of out of control. I’d barely settled into my new apartment, and then suddenly I was saying yes to mentoring sessions, taking on extra client prototype work, redesigning my whole portfolio—like I had to fix my entire life in one sprint. It felt like too much, so… I thought I should talk to someone.
During this time, have you been needing much less sleep than usual?
Yeah… for a few nights, I think I only slept like three or four hours. But I’d wake up feeling like I was fine, like I should just use the extra time to get things done.
During that time, did you feel unusually euphoric or high?

Yeah… kind of. Earlier this month I felt almost, I don’t know, electric sometimes. Really upbeat. But then I’d flip and snap at people—like a contractor, or my sister—over tiny delays, like they were somehow getting in my way on purpose.
During that upbeat, driven time, did you feel unusually powerful, gifted, or capable of things most people couldn’t do?
I don’t know… not like that, I don’t think. I felt more confident, maybe, like I could handle a lot, but I wouldn’t say I thought I was unusually gifted or anything.
During that energized period, did your behavior cause serious problems at work, financially, socially, or legally?

Yeah… financially, I guess. I bought some expensive light fixtures and software add-ons, and even booked a last-minute flight. At the time it felt justified, but afterward I realized I’d hit my savings pretty hard.
How many days in a row did that unusually energized and upbeat period last?
Um… it’s hard to separate into exact days. It’s kind of been like that since I moved into the apartment, so… about a month, I guess.
During that energized period, were you talking more than usual?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I noticed myself talking a lot more… maybe a little, but nothing that stood out to me.
During that energized period, were you hospitalized because of it?
No. I wasn’t hospitalized or anything like that.
During that energized period, were you more driven than usual to start or take on lots of projects or activities?
Yeah… I guess so. I was suddenly signing up for mentoring sessions, taking on extra prototype work for clients, and trying to redo my whole portfolio. It felt like I needed to fix everything at once.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yeah… lately, yes. Most days I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling, and it just sort of sits there. Even when nothing’s really wrong, I’ll feel like I could cry over something stupid, like a mug left in the sink.
During that energized period, did it make you unable to function normally in your day-to-day life?
Kind of, yeah. I mean… I missed a design review, which isn’t like me. And I’ve been avoiding friends and family because I’m embarrassed about how scattered and unreliable I’ve seemed.
During that energized period, did your thoughts feel like they were racing?
I’m not sure. I don’t know if I’d call it racing… my mind was just kind of busy, I guess. Hard to pin down.
Did these symptoms begin soon after a specific stressful event, like the move to your new apartment?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been since I moved into the apartment, about a month ago, that this whole up-and-down thing got intense.
During that energized period, did you feel unusually restless or unable to sit still?
Yeah… some nights I just couldn’t sit still. I’d be pacing around the apartment, moving things, labeling bins, tweaking work mockups… it felt like if I stopped, I couldn’t really handle it.
During that energized period, did you have any experiences like hearing or seeing things other people didn’t, or strongly believing something that others said wasn’t true?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I wasn’t hearing voices or seeing things. And I don’t think I believed anything that was… not real. It was more just me feeling wound up, I guess.
During that energized time, did you feel more important, capable, or powerful than usual?
Um… I don’t know. Not really “powerful,” no. Maybe I felt like I could get more done than usual, but I wouldn’t say I felt important or anything.
Before this past month, have you had similar periods of feeling unusually energized and needing much less sleep?
Yeah… I think so. There were times before where I’d sleep maybe three or four hours for a few nights and still wake up feeling like I was fine, like I should just use the extra time to get ahead.
Before this past month, have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yeah… I think so. Lately it’s been like that most days. I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling, and sometimes even when nothing’s really wrong, I feel like I could just start crying over something stupid, like a mug left in the sink.
Did other people notice that you were acting noticeably different from your usual self during that energized period?
I’m not really sure. No one said anything directly, at least not that I remember. I might’ve seemed a little more busy or keyed up, but… I don’t know if people noticed.
During that energized time, were you noticeably more productive or active than usual?

Yeah… I guess I was. I’d get kind of unable to sit still—like moving furniture around, labeling storage bins, tweaking design mockups late at night. Sometimes I’d just pace around the apartment because stopping felt… hard.
